title: What a signing op may wait for while it holds the wallet nonce lock: wait() and RPC timeouts, and what happens on a timeout, a replacement or a reorg

options.name: Keep current behaviour: wait() with no timeout under the lock, ethers 300 s idle timeouts on RPC and relay calls, wait errors not classified, inclusion final at one confirmation
options.risk: A tx that is never mined freezes every later buy and exit of the wallet for the life of the process (AUD-TX-002, including every Base/Arbitrum private submit); one hung RPC call holds the lock for minutes (AUD-TX-008).

options.name: Bounded wait under the lock, then reconcile receipt + nonce and keep the lock until the nonce is settled or replaced
options.behavior_impact: No wait is unbounded; a stuck tx is replaced (same nonce, higher fee) or cancelled with an alert, so the queue moves again.
options.risk: Replacing a stuck sell or buy costs extra gas and needs the replacement fee rules per chain; a wrong timeout value can replace a tx that would have mined.

options.name: Bounded wait, then release the lock and reconcile the pending tx in the background
options.behavior_impact: Other ops proceed at once after the timeout.
options.risk: The next op signs while the earlier tx is still pending: with the "pending" vs "latest" nonce sources mixed in the code, two txs can contend for one nonce, the collision the lock exists to prevent.

recommendation: bounded-wait-reconcile, with RPC_TIMEOUT_MS wired to every provider and relay call, wait() errors classified (replacement receipt used), and a per-chain confirmation depth before teardown. Decide with OD-17: this card sets how long one op may hold the nonce lock, OD-17 sets who gets the lock next.
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract). This card covers S1 capital findings, which cannot rest on the default: until it is decided and fixed it blocks the live re-entry gate.
behavior_impact: Decides whether one stuck or slow transaction can block every later trade of the wallet.
needed_by: Phase 24 discussion (capital fixes, after the Phase 23 real-path proof)
